note: Written by the NBA admin chat from its own NBA-Hxx decisions (nba/LEARNING.md). Public: shown on /nba/results/. status: next, testing, measuring, proposed, adopted, rejected.
rule: Changes are made one at a time, each backed by a backtest on past seasons. Nothing changes because of one night.

tests.title: Smaller penalty when a team is missing a lot of players at once.
tests.result: Heavily injured teams have beaten Leo's number so far. Early read.

tests.title: One more read of the injury report before the 8 PM tips.
tests.result: Those games are read more than an hour before tip today.

tests.title: Keep the last DraftKings line seen when none is posted at the final read.
tests.result: One game so far had no line to grade against.

tests.title: How often day to day players sit.
tests.result: Leo counts them at 40%. Needs 50 listings before the number is refit.

tests.title: Whether the DraftKings line moves toward Leo's number by tip.
Honest cover chance.
tests.result: Past seasons show the side of the spread Leo likes covers about 51 to 52% of the time whatever the gap, so the gap is shown for information only.

tests.title: Final read close to tip.
tests.result: Leo reads the injury report again at 6:40 PM and 9:40 PM Eastern.

tests.title: Closing line saved for every game.
tests.result: Used only to judge Leo, never as an input.

tests.title: A different weight on last season in early ratings.
tests.result: Backtest: the current setting is at or near the best.

tests.title: Six model ideas: minutes redistribution, plus minus, recency, fatigue and two others.
tests.result: None beat the current model on 1,055 past games.
